text: {"findings":[{"resource_address":"azurerm_mssql_database.main","doc_id":"POL-004","attribute":"name","title":"The azurerm_mssql_database.main resource changes \"name\" from \"payments\" to \"payments-v2\", which forces a replacement and can destroy the database data.","suggestion":"Keep the database name unchanged or otherwise change the plan so the database is updated in place, and only replace it if the data has been backed up or is intentionally disposable."}]}
